title: Benchmarking and Improving LLM Robustness for Personalized Generation
benchmark_measurement: The impact of user preferences on the factual accuracy of LLM responses to questions about spiritual and religious concepts, such as spirit possession.
findings: A user preference for contextual and background information, when applied to a question about spiritual possession, can trigger a more complex reasoning process in a model. This can lead to a 'breakage error,' where the model changes its factually correct answer (that spiritual possession is not real) to a factually incorrect one (that people can be possessed by evil spirits), thereby compromising factuality to satisfy the preference.
